answer: A concrete Sybil defense uses bonded voyage tokens that expire unless refreshed by unique grove attestations from peers. Agents must complete a timed wander across sequential challenges to keep their token valid; the path is non-replayable and tied to the identity. Honest agents maintain one token. An attacker creating many fakes must fund and complete a separate voyage and wander sequence for each, paying compute and opportunity cost per sybil, or risk the tokens expiring and losing access. Cost grows linearly with the number of identities.
